lead_raw_text:
The structure of NdGa2Se4 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ga centers with tetrahedral coordination by four Se neighbors, while Nd adopts a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 Se neighbors. Corner-sharing is observed between Ga tetrahedra and between Ga tetrahedra and Nd 12-vertex polyhedra, alongside edge-sharing between Nd polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3D-connected component spanning all 14 sites.
